ideas.title: Build a Ski Jump ⛷️
ideas.hook: Draw your own ski ramp on the mountain, then send a ragdoll skier flying off it. The farther and wilder the flight, the more cash you land.
core_loop: Shape the ramp by dragging points on the slope
Push off and launch your ragdoll skier
Earn cash for distance, flips and crashes
Unlock taller hills and springier ramp pieces
Beat your best jump on the next hill
ideas.twist: Ramp pieces you place stay on the hill for other players to use, so the server builds one huge shared course over time.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top rising mechanic at 2.85 momentum (44 new games), led by Throw Food For Animals (211,784 CCU) and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (174,338). Paint / create is rising at 1.58 and the "Build a ___" formula at 1.27 with Build Your World! 🔨 (9,400).
ideas.differentiator: Launch games give you a fixed cannon; here you draw the ramp, so every jump is your own design.

ideas.title: Be a Wrecking Ball 🏗️
ideas.hook: You are the wrecking ball. Swing on your crane chain into buildings, smash them to rubble and grow bigger with every block you break.
core_loop: Swing into a building and break as many parts as you can
Collect cash from falling rubble
Grow your ball heavier and your chain longer
Unlock bigger districts with skyscrapers
Rebirth into a giant ball that flattens whole blocks
ideas.twist: Every few minutes a demolition contract names one tower; the player who knocks it down first takes the bonus.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch leads at 2.85 momentum with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (174,338 CCU). Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.78 with Sandworm Playground (15,548), Giant / huge at 2.49 and Physics Sim at 2.83. The "Be a ___" formula is up to 1.32 with ⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (7,756).
ideas.differentiator: Destruction games hand you a hammer; here you are the swinging ball, and your size is your progress.

ideas.title: Dig Cake for Candy 🍰
ideas.hook: A giant birthday cake sits in the middle of town. Dig down through frosting, sponge and jam layers to find the rare candy buried inside, then sell it at your sweet stand.
core_loop: Dig through cake layers with your spoon or shovel
Find candies, rarer the deeper you go
Sell candy at your stand for cash
Buy better diggers and bigger bags
Reach the next layer for new candy
ideas.twist: The cake is shared and slowly fills back in with fresh frosting, so the deepest tunnels race the refill.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.78 momentum (43 new games) with Sandworm Playground (15,548 CCU) and [🐣UPD] Run A Farm! (7,376). Food / candy is up at 1.46 with My Cookie Store 🍪[BETA] (4,727), and Giant / huge is at 2.49.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games dig rock and ore; this digs a giant cake, so every layer looks and tastes different.

ideas.title: Be a Tank Racer 🪖
ideas.hook: Race tanks around a war-torn track and fire at the tanks ahead of you. First across the line wins, but only if your armor survives the shells.
core_loop: Pick a tank and join a race lobby
Drive the course and shoot rivals to slow them
Grab repair and ammo pickups on the track
Win cash and parts by placing
Upgrade engine, turret and armor
ideas.twist: Shells blast holes and shortcuts in the track walls, so the course changes every lap.
ideas.why_now: Race / drive + Shooter is the second strongest pairing in new games (5 games, 201,478 CCU). Shooter is at 1.64 momentum (up 1.03 this week) with Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (27,367), Race / drive at 1.48 (up 0.50) with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (10,403), and Military / war at 1.25 with Voxel Wars (15,188).
ideas.differentiator: Tank games are slow battles and racers have no weapons; this is a fast race where the cannon is your way to pass.

ideas.title: Escape the Drill Sergeant 🎖️
ideas.hook: Boot camp is a nightmare. Run the obstacle course before the angry drill sergeant catches you and sends you back to the start.
core_loop: Start the course when the whistle blows
Climb walls, crawl under nets and jump mud pits
Stay ahead of the chasing sergeant
Reach the next checkpoint for medals
Spend medals on speed and stamina
ideas.twist: The sergeant gets faster each time a player in the server finishes, so late runners face a tougher chase.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run with Military / war is an open gap (score 2.64). Escape / run is at 1.26 momentum with 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (10,090 CCU), the Escape subgenre at 1.67, and the "Escape ___" formula is up 0.16 to 1.08 with Escape the Basement! (2,497). Military / war is rising at 1.25 with Voxel Wars (15,188).
ideas.differentiator: Military games are about fighting; this is a funny boot-camp chase where the only enemy is your sergeant.

ideas.title: Rent Horses for Gold 🐴
ideas.hook: Run the stable at the edge of the kingdom. Rent horses to knights heading off on quests, and they come back with gold, loot or a tired horse.
core_loop: Feed and groom horses in your stable
Rent them to passing knights
Collect gold and quest loot when they return
Buy faster, rarer horses and bigger stalls
Unlock harder quests that pay more
ideas.twist: Some knights bring horses back hurt or never return, so you choose which knights to trust with your best horses.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop with Fantasy / medieval is an open gap (score 2.15). Sell / run a shop is rising at 1.15 momentum (36 new games) with [💎] Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (12,100 CCU) and Sell a Million Sushi (5,219). The "___ for ___" formula holds 1.07 with Jump for Cases🎲 (7,685).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell food to walk-ins; here you rent out horses and wait to see what the quest brings back.

ideas.title: Doodle Soldiers for Medals ✏️
ideas.hook: Draw your soldiers, tanks and walls on paper, and they come to life on the battlefield. Better drawings fight harder.
core_loop: Draw units with your ink budget
Send them into battle against another player's army
Win medals when your army holds the field
Unlock new ink colours that give units powers
Climb the ranks to bigger battles
ideas.twist: Units are judged by how they are drawn: longer legs run faster, thicker lines make tougher armor.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.58 momentum with ⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (7,756 CCU) and Backseat Rally (4,555). Fight / battle is up 0.37 this week to 1.12, and Military / war is at 1.25 with Voxel Wars (15,188) and Ragdoll Wars! (5,380).
ideas.differentiator: War games give you set units; here every soldier is something you drew, so no two armies look alike.

ideas.title: Grow a Giant Pearl 🦪
ideas.hook: Farm oysters on your own stretch of reef. Feed them, wait, and crack them open for pearls that grow huge and glow in rare colours.
core_loop: Plant oysters on your reef plot
Feed them plankton to grow their pearls
Crack them open for pearls
Sell pearls or keep rare ones in your collection
Expand your reef and buy better oysters
ideas.twist: The longer you wait before cracking an oyster, the bigger the pearl, but a passing storm can wash unopened ones away.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is rising at 1.57 momentum (49 new games) with [🐜] Ant Evolution (17,036 CCU), [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution (10,635) and Throw a Seed (9,426). Giant / huge is at 2.49 with [FOREST] Durian Garden 🍈 (4,597), and Ocean / pirates is at 1.20.
ideas.differentiator: Farm games grow crops on land; this grows pearls under the sea, and size is the whole point.

ideas.title: +1 Anchor Weight ⚓
ideas.hook: Every time you drop your anchor it gets +1 heavier. Heavier anchors sink deeper, and deeper water hides better treasure.
core_loop: Drop your anchor off the dock
Gain +1 weight each drop
Sink deeper and grab treasure on the way
Rebirth for weight multipliers
Reach the next ocean zone
ideas.twist: Sea creatures grab onto your anchor on the way down and drag up as pets that boost your weight gain.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula is still at 1.88 momentum (35 new games, down 0.32 this week) with [🌍UPD 5] +1 Venom Evolution (12,660 CCU) and [⚔️CLANS] +1 Gun Forge (8,131). Ocean / pirates is at 1.20 with [🏝️ISLAND] Criminal Simulator 💰 (14,138), and depth games like [UPD6 🎉] Depth Incremental (13,895) lead the 1.75 linear-course map style.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow speed or size; here the stat is weight, so the number literally pulls you deeper.

ideas.title: Blast Asteroids for Ore ☄️
ideas.hook: Fly a mining ship through an asteroid field and blast rocks apart for ore. Big asteroids crack into smaller ones, and the rare cores hide in the middle.
core_loop: Fly into the asteroid field
Shoot asteroids to break them apart
Collect the ore and cores that float out
Sell at the station for upgrades
Push into deeper fields with giant asteroids
ideas.twist: Other players can shoot the ore you broke loose, so you protect your haul or race to grab theirs.
ideas.why_now: Space is the fastest-rising theme at 2.86 momentum (up 1.20 this week) with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (10,811 CCU). Shooter is at 1.64 (up 1.03) with Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (27,367), and Break / mine / dig is at 1.78 with Sandworm Playground (15,548).
ideas.differentiator: Mining games use pickaxes on the ground; this mines by shooting in open space, with other ships as rivals.
